parameters.description: Comma-separated grouping dimensions, e.g. user,model. Each must be one of user, model, provider, with no repeats. Defaults to user.
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.description: Window start, RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD (default 30 days back, including today)
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Filter: served model of the underlying event, exact match. Narrows which charges are included; does not change the grouping — use group_by for that
parameters.name: model
